errors.text: The proposed 750°C recovery mechanism substitutes phase-boundary smoothing for the target mechanism of reduced ordering plus formation of ductile transition zones along phase boundaries.

No quantitative or operational critical chemical-ordering boundary is supplied; the answer invokes a critical L12/SRO degree but does not define a measurable threshold such as an order parameter, superlattice-intensity ratio, APBE, or deviation from Ni3Al stoichiometry.

The cited evidence does not directly support the aging-induced L12/APBE/jagged-boundary mechanism in AlCoCrFeNi2.1; E3 and E4 concern dislocations in a chemically ordered BCC refractory HEA and are only indirect analogies.
